creators.name: dmv3ats (DMV Eats)
creators.beat: DC/NoVA halal + immigrant-food creator with a real following and findable, place-specific content; used only as ONE corroborating source (e.g., Chaska), never a lone authority.
creators.note: Corroboration only. Popularity verifiable (active account, place tags). Not counted toward the 2-credible gate on its own.

outlets.name: Asian Fortune
outlets.note: Authentic community media; credible for immigrant-restaurant profiles (e.g., Fairfax Inn, Filipino).

outlets.name: The New Yorker
outlets.note: Calvin Trillin's 'Where's Chang?' (2010) — the piece that made China Star/Peter Chang a cult; institutional-caliber corroboration.

outlets.name: Baltimore Magazine
outlets.note: Credible for the Helmand/Qayum Karzai lineage behind Kabobi by The Helmand.

outlets.name: DCist (WAMU)
outlets.note: Already in the DC palette (DCIST/WAMU). Corroborated Jiwa Singapura's opening; listed here for completeness.

note: MARGINALREVOLUTION (marginalrevolution.com) is Tyler Cowen's blog and is cited under the existing TYLERCOWEN key — same author as the Ethnic Dining Guide, treated as a single rank-1 authority, not two independent sources. Where a Wow Nepal-style pick rests on Tyler Cowen, a second independent outlet (FFXnow) was added to satisfy the >=2-credible-sources bar. FFXNOW, TYSONSREPORTER, NOVAMAG, ARLMAG, WASHINGTONIAN, WAPO, FXVA, ANNANDALETODAY, VISITFALLSCHURCH are existing palette keys.
